description: Upload and moderate a PNG/JPEG/WebP image for video generation. Provide raw base64 (no data URL), maximum 3 MiB decoded. Use the returned url as imageUrl or lastFrameUrl. Requires a key. Clients with file/shell access can instead POST multipart file to https://stivio.ai/api/upload with the same Bearer key; do not ask the language model to transcribe image bytes.
name: upload_image
